text:
sara_cs: Quick sync — Halcyon Labs dedicated bring-up next Tue. Need final quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and one owner for the load test. Can we lock this down today?

tom_platform: I can own the load test. Proposal: baseline 1200 qps sustained, 30m soak, spike to 2500 for 10m.

leo_se: Confirming model: rwd-3.2-large-quant (customer requested quant profile). Watch for kv-cache warmup impact.

nishant_re: For warmup, recommend prefix priming ~1M tokens across routes to populate KV cache before traffic shift.

elaine_ops: KMS and audit logging are ready. Ops will run the warmup script post quota provisioning. Need last-call on egress/VPC peering window.

sara_cs: Good. Tom — schedule a staging dry-run tomorrow 09:30 PT and use ramp->soak->spike template. Put artifacts in the runbook.

tom_platform: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-03-24 09:30 PT. Script I'll run: `./loadtest --profile halcyon --qps 1200 --duration 30m --spike 2500 --spike-dur 10m`

deploy-bot: Loadtest job created: job/lt-3367. Results will auto-post to #customer-success and attach to runbook.

leo_se: Two measurement priorities: token-cost delta and response p95. If p95 exceeds 400ms we fallback to q-compact variant and open a ticket.

nishant_re: Quota proposal: provision 2x their expected peak concurrency initially. Autoscale policy: min_instances=2, max_instances=12, scale_up_threshold=70% CPU or NVMM, scale_down_cooldown=5m.

elaine_ops: I'll coordinate network egress/peering 08:00-09:00 PT on go-live day. Ops checklist will be in the runbook under `ops/halcyon`.

sara_cs: I'll send Halcyon the enablement checklist and confirm their training slots. Renewal note: they mentioned cost sensitivity — we should surface Optimize's quantization plan in the QBR.

leo_se: Agreed. Enable Optimize suggestions and run a quick quant advisory before go-live to prevent surprises.

tom_platform: After dry-run I'll upload graphs (qps, p50/p95, token-cost-per-1k) and heatmap of sequence lengths to `runbook/halcyon/2026-03-24`.

sara_cs: Plan for post-run 30-min sync with Halcyon + internal owners (CS, SE, Ops, Platform). I'll create the invite. :calendar:

tom_platform: noted, will post test results and triage notes there.

sara_cs: Thanks all — keeping this thread for status updates only. :thumbsup:
